card.name: Inside codes, numbers and brand names
card.fires_on: Pieces inside NDC numbers, section cross-reference numbers like (5.1, 9.2), years, and partway through capitalized brand names such as ZOKINVY or JUXTAPID.

modes.label: Numbers and codes
modes.description: A digit, hyphen or period inside an NDC code, a year, or a section reference in parentheses.

modes.label: Brand names
modes.description: A middle piece of an uppercase brand name when the name is repeated in a warning or instruction.

modes.description: The period or space between section numbers in a cross-reference list.
